count_caution: Combined editorial register, including existing concepts and unsourced proposals. Not an additive count of new playable categories. No clade copies or max/min variants counted as new concepts.

catalogs.title: Existing comparative trait catalogs
catalogs.coverage: Mixed worldwide animal groups; per-field coverage required

locomotion.title: Cloyed & Dell locomotion database
locomotion.coverage: 884 organisms; exclude non-animals; locomotion modes kept separate

travel.title: Dyer et al. travel speeds
travel.coverage: Eight animal groups; different sampling protocols and some unidentified taxa

jump.title: Comparative jumping performance
jump.coverage: Comparative jump paper mixes calculated heights and reported measurements; primary endpoints need verification

jump-direct.title: Direct gerbil jumping experiment
jump-direct.coverage: Gerbils only; not enough for broad mixed-animal boards

diving.title: Universal constraints on diving
diving.coverage: Insects, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals; literature with study context

bird-diving.title: Diving parameters of 53 bird species
bird-diving.coverage: Birds only; global literature, measured logger and stopwatch protocols

movement.title: Movebank public data repository
movement.coverage: Multiple groups and continents; public studies only; unequal deployment durations

bite.title: Insect bite force database
bite.coverage: 654 insect species, 13 orders, four continents; independent specimen gates

bite-vertebrate.title: Empirical voluntary bite performance methods
bite-vertebrate.coverage: Vertebrate literature; gape, biting point and substrate matter

pull.title: Instrumented passalus beetle pulling experiment
pull.coverage: One beetle species; method lead, not a cross-species table

hearing.title: Animal Audiograms
hearing.coverage: Multiple animal groups; air/water, age, method, threshold and frequency required

vision.title: Comparative visual acuity review
vision.coverage: Hundreds of animals; anatomical estimates and behavioral tests mixed

smell.title: Mammalian odor detection and discrimination
smell.coverage: 20 mammal species; individual odors and identical discrimination tasks

sound.title: Calibrated song amplitude measurements
sound.coverage: 17 European songbird species; context and corrected distance recorded

sound-review.title: Cross-taxon sound pressure review
sound-review.coverage: Air and underwater measurements; different reference pressures

diet.title: CarniDIET
diet.coverage: 103 terrestrial carnivorous mammals; study/site/time and diet methods retained

food-types.title: Observed mammalian food types
food-types.coverage: 1437 terrestrial mammals; four explicit food classes, not prey-species counts

hostplants.title: LepTraits
hostplants.coverage: Butterflies and moths; hostplant discovery and study effort bias

food-intake.title: Measured captive moose intake
food-intake.coverage: One mammal species; daily food measurements; no cross-species database yet

fasting.title: Food/water restriction physiology
fasting.coverage: Sand gazelles only; imposed restriction is not maximum endurance

thermal.title: GlobTherm
thermal.coverage: Multiple groups; remove non-animals; critical vs lethal endpoints separate

social.title: PanTHERIA and COMBINE reported traits
social.coverage: Mammals worldwide; reported fields may still contain underlying estimates

nests.title: Nest traits for the world’s birds
nests.coverage: Birds globally; numerical building time and dimensions alongside nominal types

burrows.title: Direct vole burrow measurements
burrows.coverage: One vole species; local surveyed burrows, not mammal-wide records

population.title: Living Planet Database
population.coverage: Monitored vertebrate populations; local counts, densities and abundance proxies mixed

iucn.title: IUCN Red List assessments
iucn.coverage: Global assessed animals; date, population intervals and DD/NE must be retained

horns.title: Comparative bovid horn measurements
horns.coverage: 115 bovids, 80 female horned; sex-specific published maxima

antlers.title: Comparative cervid antler size
antlers.coverage: 31 male cervid species lengths; 20 antler weights; seasonal development

anatomy.title: Mammalian Species accounts
anatomy.coverage: Species accounts; illustrative gaur account includes ears and horns; broader audit needed

sleep.title: Phylogeny of Sleep database
sleep.coverage: Mammals; recording duration, EEG vs behavior, captivity and feeding documented

torpor.title: Daily torpor and hibernation
torpor.coverage: 214 bird/mammal species; numerical table downloaded; duration, temperature and metabolism endpoints

torpor-phenotypes.title: Hibernation phenotype matrix
torpor-phenotypes.coverage: Birds/mammals; MaxTorporLength is a category, not hours

development.title: Comparative complex life cycles
development.coverage: Multiple larval-stage animals including crustaceans and insects

growth.title: Comparative animal growth
growth.coverage: Comparative growth data; fitted growth coefficients are not raw growth rates

care.title: Mammalian paternal care
care.coverage: Care type/presence is categorical; does not support longest-care duration

healing.title: Comparative wound healing
healing.coverage: Primates and rodents; different injuries, uncertain ordering among nonhuman species

regrowth.title: Lizard tail regrowth
regrowth.coverage: Five wall lizard species; narrow specialist comparison only

regeneration.title: Comparative regeneration literature
regeneration.coverage: Qualitative capabilities; no common whole-animal regeneration score

seasonal.title: Direct seasonal mammal body composition
seasonal.coverage: Alpine marmots; one species; body mass variation is not fat percentage

cognition.title: MacLean shared self-control tasks
cognition.coverage: Birds/mammals; shared A-not-B and cylinder tests; no general IQ ranking

fossils.title: Paleobiology Database API
fossils.coverage: Global fossil taxa; species/genus/clade ranks and geological intervals separate

description.title: Catalogue of Life
description.coverage: Global taxa; authorship year can refer to a later combination; verify original description

domestication.title: Ancient DNA and domestication evidence
domestication.coverage: Domestic lineages; archaeological bounds and competing origins retained

translocation.title: IUCN conservation translocation case studies
translocation.coverage: Selected global case studies; national reintroduction is not global species rediscovery
